iti6:1.1: (Ek. I.) Vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā vuttam-arahatā ti me sutaṃ.
iti6:2.1: Ekadhammaṃ bhikkhave pajahatha. Ahaṃ vo pāṭibhogo anāgāmitāya. Katamaṃ ekadhammaṃ? Mānaṃ bhikkhave ekadhammaṃ pajahatha. Ahaṃ vo pāṭibhogo anāgāmitāyā-ti. Etam-atthaṃ bhagavā avoca, tatthetaṃ iti vuccati:
iti6:3.1: Yena mānena mattāse sattā gacchanti duggatiṃ | taṃ mānaṃ sammad-aññāya pajahanti vipassino | pahāya na punāyanti imaṃ lokaṃ kudācanan-ti ||
iti6:4.1: Ayam-pi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutan-ti ||6||
